_note: Cultures (in culture groups), ethnicities and religions. A province whose culture isn't accepted by its owner gets unrest; a different culture group or ethnicity adds more. Religions give their followers' nations modifiers. Names other than Pigs, Pigmen, Humans, Angels and the Will of Eden are placeholders.

Pigman.text: Pigmen: upright, clever, often found in the labs and mines.

Human.text: Skyfallin humans. They need breathing masks below the clouds.

Chicken.text: The chickens of Combustion Ayam: small, quick and endlessly inventive.

Oceanian.text: People of the Deep Blue. They breathe water and need oxygen masks on land.

Satian.text: The island folk of the Satian Islands (placeholder).

Fuarlander.text: The tall, hardy folk of Fuarland, at home in the cold of northern Terra Incognito (placeholder).

Stellarin.text: The Stellarins of the eastern plains, a people of watchers and thinkers (placeholder).

Llama.text: Llamas of the western highlands: sure-footed, woolly, and not to be insulted.

Lotus Faith.text: The faith of the Holy Empire (placeholder name).

Will of Eden.text: Skyfall's devotion to Eden, who raised the islands.

Mud Spirits.text: The old ways of the wild boars (placeholder).

Black Moon.text: Worship of the Doomsday Portal and the Black Moon that opens it. The anomalies spare the faithful.

Combustion Creed.text: Combustion Ayam's faith in the eternal flame and the engine that harnesses it.

The Long Road.text: The caravan faith of the Yellow Road: every journey is a prayer (placeholder).

The Deep.text: Reverence for the dark water and what sleeps in it (placeholder).

The Tidewheel.text: The Satian faith in the turning of the tides: what goes out comes back (placeholder).

The Old Fires.text: Fuarland's ancestral faith: hearth-fires kept burning through the long winters, one for every fallen warrior (placeholder).

The Starpath.text: The Stellarin belief that the stars are a road, and that a people who learn enough will one day walk it (placeholder).

separatists.name: Separatists
separatists.text: Want their land out of the empire.

zealots.name: Religious zealots
zealots.text: Want their province to follow their faith.

peasants.name: Peasant revolt
peasants.text: Angry about taxes, war and hunger.

entities.name: Entities
entities.text: Things from beyond the Doomsday Portal. They answer to no one, and time reversing does not send them back.
